analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (93,620 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (109,617 KRW/109,675 KRW/104,726 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (139,747 KRW/110,714 KRW): Confirmation of weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (27.9%) + Current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.9→42.3): Failed to exit oversold, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (702.5844→-424.4041): Worsening, signaling a bearish turn.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 99,559 KRW): Entering the lower band approach zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (98,695 KRW): Close to Pivot S1 (93,370 KRW), based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (115,010 KRW): Potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low in progress): Interpreted as continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.17x): Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): For buying, confirmation of RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement is needed; for selling, confirmation of ADX trend formation is required.
